claim: Around 300 professional cyclists, triathletes, sports directors, mechanics and physios live in Girona, with pro teams including Cannondale-Garmin, EF-Drapac, Mitchelton-Scott and Israel Cycling Academy based there.
quote: About 300 professional cyclists, triathletes, sports directors, mechanics and physiotherapists live here ... professional teams are based here: Cannondale-Garmin, today Education First-Drapac, Mitchelton-Scott, Israel Cycling Academy

claim: Pros pick Girona for its year-round training climate, quiet roads with considerate drivers, and diverse terrain spanning flat straights, hill climbs, the Costa Brava and the nearby Pyrenees.
quote: because of the climate, which allows you to train all year round ... good roads with little traffic and drivers who are very considerate of cyclists ... diverse terrain that allows cycling on long straights as well as in steep climbs in the hills

claim: Girona is established as a cycling capital with around 100 pro riders living there at least part of the year; signature climbs include Rocacorba (the Girona classic) and Els Angels, plus the Banyoles lake loop.
quote: Girona is now well established as a capital of cycling ... Rocacorba ... the Girona classic ... famous (or infamous)

claim: Eat Sleep Cycle's Girona hub combines a bike shop, workshop, apparel store, bike-hire centre, cafe and terrace in the city centre and refreshes its rental fleet annually from leading brands.
quote: Eat Sleep Cycle offers a bike shop, workshop, apparel store, bike hire centre, café and sunny terrace in the centre of Girona.

claim: The 2026 Girona bike-hire fleet features newly released models including the Colnago Y1Rs, with the aim of giving renters a brand-new-bike feeling.
quote: The 2026 Girona bike rental fleet features newly released models ... the Colnago Y1Rs, which is available for rental in Girona in 2026 and is expected to be fully booked.

claim: The Carrilet I greenway runs 58 km from Olot (440 m) down to Girona (70 m) along an old narrow-gauge railway through the Garrotxa Volcanic Area and Ter valley, suitable for cyclists and hikers.
quote: The Carrilet I greenway descends smoothly from Olot (440 m) to Girona (70 m) ... It begins in the Garrotxa Volcanic Area, and following the old narrow-gauge railway line, reaches the Ter valley

claim: The Carrilet II greenway stretches about 42 km on a gentle incline from Girona to the coast at Sant Feliu de Guixols, following the former Girona-beach rail line and passing old stations converted to cyclist-friendly bars.
quote: The Carrilet II greenway stretches out 41.9 km. With a smooth incline from Girona to Sant Feliu de Guíxols (15 m), its highest point is in the municipality of Llagostera (149 m)

claim: The Olot-Girona Carrilet route, with around 1.5 million users a year, is the most popular via verde (greenway) in Spain.
quote: With 1.5 million users a year, this is the most popular via verde (greenway) in Spain.

claim: The Lake Banyoles loop is a flat, easy circular trail of about 6.9 km (roughly 1h45) with continuous lake views and traditional fishing huts, walkable or cyclable for all ages.
quote: the Tour around Lake Banyoles, a 4.3-mile (6.9 km) trail that takes 1 hour 46 minutes to complete with easy, circular paths offering continuous views of the lake and passing traditional fishing huts

claim: Day-trip hikes near Girona include the La Garrotxa volcanic park circuit of Santa Margarida and Croscat volcanoes, a ~12 km loop of about 3h24.
quote: the Volcán de Santa Margarida and Volcán del Croscat - Circular through the Natural Park of the Volcanic Zone of La Garrotxa, a 7.5-mile (12.1 km) trail that takes 3 hours 24 minutes

claim: Guided sea-cave kayaking and snorkelling tours on the Costa Brava explore coves, caves and cliffs around the Bay of Sant Pol-S'Agaro, with equipment and lifejackets provided.
quote: kayak and snorkel in coves, caves, channels, exploring the cliffs and islands of the Bay of Sant Pol-S'Agaró

claim: Costa Brava kayak-and-snorkel tours near Girona run from spots like Blanes (from ~$47, 1.5h) and L'Estartit to the protected Medes Islands (from ~$34, 2.5h).
quote: tours in Blanes (starting from $47 for 1.5 hours) and from L'Estartit to the Medes Islands (from $34 for 2.5 hours)

claim: Globus Emporda has run hot-air balloon flights over the Emporda for more than 20 years, departing early morning from Colomers (~30 min from Girona) for roughly an hour aloft over fields and villages.
quote: More than 20 years flying in the Empordà ... Approximately one hour floating silently over fields and villages ... Parc del Ter s/n, 17144 Colomers, Girona
